title: Register Program for the Codec
statement: For a Boolean nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ and a mode $m$ chosen from the four cases valid, initial, accepting, and step, define a register program with $21$ registers and two deciders by the instruction assigned to each label. The labels and their instructions are precisely those in the definition: the program scans and validates encoded inputs, performs register updates and decider calls, and returns a Boolean answer according to the selected mode.
hypotheses_covered: A mode $m$ in the four-element set {valid, initial, accepting, step}
caveat: The definition is an extensive label-indexed instruction table. This concise description identifies the program construction and its scope but does not enumerate every label-to-instruction assignment.
